mapper.insert: INSERT INTO sys_role (role_code, role_name) VALUES ('user', '普通用户') ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE role_code = VALUES(role_code)
INSERT INTO sys_permission (permission_code, permission_name) VALUES ('school:read', '查看院校数据'), ('recommend:use', '使用冲稳保推荐') ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE permission_code = VALUES(permission_code)

INSERT IGNORE INTO sys_role_permission (role_id, permission_id) SELECT r.id, p.id FROM sys_role r CROSS JOIN sys_permission p WHERE r.role_code = 'user' AND p.permission_code IN ('school:read', 'recommend:use')
INSERT IGNORE INTO sys_user_role (user_id, role_id) SELECT #{userId}, id FROM sys_role WHERE role_code = #{roleCode}
